connectors.refdes: Optional ULS Automation Interface · J2 programmable inputs
connectors.form: Eight numbered J2 contacts; manufacturer pin labels shown. Installed option-board revision unverified.
connectors.scope: Optional Automation Interface reference; VLS6.60 guide family includes discontinued model. Optional-board fitment on the Appropedia machine is not established. Input functions are user-programmable; local configuration is unknown.

connectors.refdes: Optional ULS Automation Interface · J6 programmable status outputs
connectors.form: Four numbered J6 contacts; manufacturer pin labels shown. PNP/NPN mode is selected by board switch; fitted setting unknown.
connectors.scope: Optional Automation Interface reference. The guide warns outputs are for information/status and not to drive external devices; no third-party safety-device support. Board fitment and mode on the Appropedia machine unknown.

connectors.refdes: Optional ULS Automation Interface · J5 reserved connector
connectors.form: Four diagram-marked positions J5-1 through J5-4; not an external-use connector.
connectors.scope: The board illustration marks all four J5 positions “FUTURE USE, DO NOT USE.” Preserve only as source labels; do not connect.

connectors.refdes: Optional ULS Automation Interface · J8 positions
connectors.form: Two numeral-marked J8 positions in board illustration; no function assignment shown.
connectors.scope: Board illustration shows J8 pin marks 1 and 2 only; accessible manual does not identify connector function, electrical role, or whether these are user terminals.

contacts.name: Function unspecified · printed J8 pin 1 mark
Function unspecified · printed J8 pin 2 mark

connectors.refdes: Optional ULS Automation Interface · PWR/COM IN
connectors.form: RJ9 type named for input; no individual contact map supplied.
connectors.scope: Manual calls this RJ9 and says the included patch cable connects it to either rear accessory port on the laser. Pin assignment, orientation and ratings not transcribed; card remains reference-only.

connectors.refdes: Optional ULS Automation Interface · PWR/COM OUT
connectors.form: Board-top label only; connector form and individual contact map unspecified.
connectors.scope: PWR/COM OUT is printed on the board illustration. No contact schedule or use instructions found in accessible manual text.

connectors.refdes: VLS6.60 family · rear accessory port(s) for Automation Interface patch cable
connectors.form: Guide says either rear accessory port; no form/contact schedule given.
connectors.scope: Manufacturer guide describes the included patch cable connecting the optional interface board with either rear machine accessory port. Local option installation and physical contacts unknown.

connectors.refdes: Universal Laser Systems · optional Automation Interface board
connectors.form: Optional board/function reference; no proof of fitment on the catalogue machine.
connectors.scope: VLS Platform User Guide explicitly covers discontinued VLS6.60 and describes this optional board. Do not treat family support as local installation evidence.
